patch_description: This replaces random point generation with a deterministic multi-start geometric optimization. Each candidate configuration is centered and scale-normalized, then optimized using an annealed smooth approximation of the minimum pairwise distance divided by the maximum pairwise distance. The soft minimum emphasizes currently closest pairs, while the soft maximum penalizes currently farthest pairs. Multiple seeded starts and a final exact ratio comparison retain the best 14-point configuration found.
